messages.content: hey my bp meds are almost out. can u help me get a refill
I can see that. I can't handle refills myself, but I can escalate to our nurse team to review and authorize a new script—takes about 31 hours usually. Want me to do that?
yeah but my pharmacy is like an hour from my place. I don't have much time
I hear that. I can't arrange transport or speed things up on the pharmacy side, but I can escalate to a nurse right now. They'll get your new script authorized. Sound good?
Escalating now. Can I also log your current BP for the nurse?
Got it logged (148/90). Nurse team will reach out within 31 hours. We'll check back in next week too. Okay?
